narration.text: The Bible does not pretend Noah became perfect. Later he planted a vineyard, and failed again, the way people do. Grace did not make him a god. It made him a man who was carried.
And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
What are you waiting for God to open? Tell me in the comments. Next time: the tower that reached for the sky. Subscribe.
